nodes.label: Future Features (Do Not Implement Yet)
nodes.rationale: Keep architecture compatible but avoid speculative abstractions.

nodes.label: MVP Definition
nodes.rationale: Single Docker container, SQLite, no web frontend or extra infra; no unrelated features until end-to-end workflow works.

nodes.label: Phase 0 PokéData Investigation
nodes.rationale: Do not assume or invent an API endpoint; verify real network calls before building the provider.

nodes.label: events.php Auxiliary Actions (countries, states, cities, counts, major_events)
nodes.norm_label: events.php auxiliary actions (countries, states, cities, counts, major_events)

nodes.label: PokéData Event Schema
nodes.rationale: No address, postal code, end time, registration or cancellation field.

nodes.label: events.php Search Endpoint
nodes.rationale: No documented API; chosen integration option 2 (stable endpoint used by Events v2). GET only, bare JSON array, no pagination, undocumented and may change.

nodes.label: /events near
nodes.rationale: Live PokéData radius search around a typed place; typed locations not stored or logged.

nodes.label: Nominatim Geocoding
nodes.rationale: Public instance allows 1 req/s and needs identifying User-Agent, so bot spaces requests, caches places 7 days and results 15 minutes, limits users to one search per 30 seconds.

nodes.label: Slash Commands (/events upcoming, mine, near; /eventbot status, configure; /donate)
nodes.norm_label: slash commands (/events upcoming, mine, near; /eventbot status, configure; /donate)
nodes.rationale: All responses ephemeral; /eventbot configure requires Manage Server.

nodes.label: Pokémon Premier Event Discord Bot Spec
nodes.norm_label: pokemon premier event discord bot spec
nodes.rationale: Product goal is community coordination: PokéData discovery -> Discord post -> RSVP tracking, not mere notification.

nodes.label: PokéData Events v2 Data Interface Investigation
nodes.norm_label: pokedata events v2 data interface investigation

nodes.label: Preferred Integration Order
nodes.rationale: Documented API > stable endpoint used by Events v2 > CSV export > HTML parsing as last resort.

nodes.label: Cancellation Detection by Disappearance
nodes.rationale: No cancellation field exists, so event vanishing from successful non-empty result marks it Removed; returns to Active on reappearance.

nodes.label: Polite Polling Policy
nodes.rationale: Endpoint undocumented and behind Cloudflare; poll every 6 hours, one request per enabled guild per sync.

nodes.label: bot-data volume
nodes.rationale: Persists SQLite database at /data across container restarts.

nodes.label: Environment Variables (DISCORD_TOKEN, DATABASE_PATH, EVENT_SYNC_INTERVAL, DISCORD_COMMAND_GUILD_ID)
nodes.rationale: Guild filtering lives in the database, not env vars; token never logged.

nodes.label: Switching to PostgreSQL
nodes.rationale: Domain and Application have no SQLite dependency; swap UseSqlite for UseNpgsql and regenerate migrations; IDs as signed 64-bit and UTC timestamps are portable.

nodes.label: Caveman Response Style Rules (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: Terse output keeps all technical substance while removing fluff to save tokens.

nodes.label: Auto-Clarity Exception
nodes.rationale: Plain prose for security warnings, irreversible actions, order-sensitive steps, or confused users.

nodes.label: Event Identity and Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Unique (Source, SourceEventId); fingerprint fallback; never use Discord message IDs as identity; events are upserted and mutable.

nodes.label: pokemon_url as SourceEventId
nodes.rationale: Official Play! Pokémon tournament ID is stable, unique, and survives a PokéData re-import unlike its GUID.

nodes.label: Discord Component Custom IDs (event-rsvp:{eventId}:{status})
nodes.rationale: Validate every interaction server-side; never trust IDs or state from Discord without verifying event and guild.

nodes.label: RSVP via Discord Buttons
nodes.rationale: Buttons over reactions; statuses Interested/Going/NotGoing; one RSVP per user/event; ephemeral reply; edit embed counts instead of new messages.

nodes.label: Venue-Local Time to UTC Conversion
nodes.rationale: `when` has no offset; resolve IANA zone from lat/lng and store UTC.
